description: Copernicus Publications' journal class copernicus.cls v10.1.35 (2026/09/08, patched for XeTeX: see below; line numbers are the shipped copy's) with its journal configuration copernicus.cfg (3 September 2026) and copernicus.bst v1.6, from the Copernicus LaTeX Macro Package v7.16 (publications.copernicus.org/Copernicus_LaTeX_Package.zip, linked from the journals' manuscript-preparation pages), used by all EGU journals. Not on CTAN or the engine's mirror; the package says each file has its own copyright, Copernicus GmbH (no open licence; kept private). Options as the template (template.tex l.12: [journal abbreviation, manuscript]): acp (Atmospheric Chemistry and Physics) and manuscript, the one-column preprint layout; without manuscript the class sets the final two-column layout. The class refuses every standard size, paper and column option (a4paper ... fleqn, l.94-110) with \@latexerr, so setup B (twocolumn) cannot be used. The class loads article [fleqn], ulem [normalem], [T5,T3,T1]{fontenc}, fontawesome5 with fontawesomesymbols-pdftex.tex, inputenc [utf8] (all but LuaTeX), babel (english), amssymb, amsmath [intlimits,fleqn,tbtags], amsthm, natbib [authoryear,round] (l.2044-2045) and, unless nohyperref, hyperref [bookmarks=true,colorlinks] (l.2312-2319). \runningtitle and \runningauthor are required: the class stops with 'You must define \runningtitle' if either is empty (l.557-558), so the preamble gives both, as the template does. The shipped copernicus.cls is patched for XeTeX, which the class does not know (it tests only for LuaTeX): \pdfoutput is undefined under XeTeX and the class stopped at the pdfoutput test, l.260 (fix session's probe; probe run 41977413848 after the patch: 0 errors with and without a title block), so its four \ifnum\pdfoutput tests read \cop@pdfoutput (1 under XeTeX, which always writes PDF); the PDF page boxes (\pdfpageattr, l.285) are left out under XeTeX; and, as under LuaTeX, inputenc and ucharacters (\DeclareUnicodeCharacter, l.1380) are not loaded. The engine's tree has no copernicus, so the copy keeps its name.
